title: Day jobs, television, movies and records since returning
summary: Punch never worked day jobs through the road years; since returning he has been on television once, made no movies, and plans to record.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: That reminds me, all those years on the road were you working days at all?
So you haven't worked days until you got back here.
When was the last day job you had before you came here?
When did you have a day job before you came back to New Orleans?
When I was on the farm at Richmond, Louisiana.
Yeah, never, that's fantastic to go all those years without working. Just play music, huh?
So you come back here and you've had a few jobs, that's right, I can remember a few of them.
Mm-hmm. Let's see, you've been on television.
Oh yeah. How many times were you on television? Just once, yeah. Just once, that's one time. Yeah.
And let's see, ever make any movies? No, I never make no movies.

I heard once they grabbed us picture in Chicago, they're playing at the Howard Street, they're playing at the Howard Street, they're playing at the Howard Street, they're playing at the Howard Street. I've seen the people around there doing all that work but I didn't think they could take
nothing else. But they said they did, they said they had us in a picture, I don't know. Of course if we know that we could have got paid for it, that's when I didn't believe it.
Have you made any records since you've been back here? Not here, no. Not any real band records or anything? No. Well you made that thing with Sam I was just telling you about.

Well yeah, but I didn't know anything about that, so Sam got to let me know something about that. But I'm really planning on if I get a little more strength making something like that, because I got some good stuff, I'll sell it all out, I'll do something with it. But of course I've got to wait a little while, yet I'm trying to rush myself up a little too fast. I've just got to wait a while.
